$comment: Durable pi-herdr-agents config. Mirrors the package config.json.example, except supervision.hangWarningMinutes is lowered from 15 to 8 so no-progress advisories arrive early enough to act on. Advisories are warning-only: they never interrupt, kill, or restart a child. Creating this file means status/role/pane/persistent settings now come from here instead of the example, so those blocks are kept explicitly. Run /reload after editing.
